newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere boosted by Juppe comments.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere boosted by Juppe comments.

text.p: Shares in Lagardere group rose strongly on Monday on the back of comments made by Prime Minister Alain Juppe in the Financial Times which were seen as supporting Lagardere, dealers said.
Juppe re-iterated in the interview that the state could split Thomson SA and sell the 58-percent stake in Thomson-CSF separately from loss-making Thomson Multimedia (TMM).

The government on Wednesday suspended the planned sale of Thomson SA to Lagardere because the independent Privatisation Commission did not accept the terms of the sale of TMM by Lagardere to Daewoo Electronics of South Korea.
At 1016 GMT, Lagardere was up 2.46 percent at 145.50 francs.
Dealers said that Juppe's comment, saying that nobody had criticised the industrial logic of Lagardere's plan to merge Matra with Thomson-CSF, was seen as supporting their side.
Shares in Thomson-CSF, meanwhile, were 1.28 percent higher at 166.20 ahead of an expected buy-out bid.
"We get the impression that the government wants Lagardere to get Thomson-CSF," an analyst said.
